meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'быть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'говорить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to talk out of, dissuade'.

examples.trans: To talk Fedya out of quitting.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и отговорить вовремя.

поделить.gloss: to divide, to split, to share out

meanings.en: to divide up, to split, to share between
meanings.note: Share out between people. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'елить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to divide, to split, to share out', paired with 'делить'.
+ dative. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мочь'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to help', paired with 'помогать'.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'laundromat', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.trans: This is a restaurant, not a laundromat.

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'видеться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to see each other, meet up', paired with 'видеться'.

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'вольняться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'quit, resign'.

examples.trans: And I am quitting in the meantime.

examples.text: Если вы мне не верите, то я прямо сейчас увольняюсь!
examples.trans: If you do not believe me, then I am quitting right now!

examples.text: Никто из поваров не хотел увольняться из команды Баринова.
examples.trans: None of the cooks wanted to resign from Barinov's team.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'говаривать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'persuade'.

examples.text: Не уговаривай меня остаться здесь, в тепле.
examples.trans: Do not persuade me to stay here in the warmth.

examples.text: Да не буду я её уговаривать.
examples.trans: I am not going to persuade her.

meanings.en: to leave on foot, go away
meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to leave, go away', paired with 'уходить'.

examples.text: Эх, Паша, Паша. Ты считать не умеешь.
